metrics.method: Full history 2025-09-14 to 2026-08-26 (1,492 rows, 849 client messages). Questions = client messages containing '?' or opening with a request phrase; 'unanswered >24h' = first team message after the question arrived more than 24h later (median lag 0.9h; ~8 further threads needed repeat nudges inside 24h). Team silence = longest gap between consecutive team-side messages (Aug 1-10 2026; Aug 17-25 was 7 days). Promises = explicit first-person commitments by our side ('I'll', 'let me', 'will start', 'shortly', 'next week'); kept if a visible confirmation followed in chat, lapsed if none ever did.
